brief:
An entire generation of Gaza's children has grown up knowing only conflict as Israel's military operations entered their fourth year, according to Middle East Eye. The children have spent their formative years amid ongoing violence, with no recollection of peacetime conditions in the territory.

The prolonged conflict has fundamentally altered childhood experiences in Gaza, reshaping how a generation develops and processes their early lives. The cumulative effect of years of warfare has become the normalized backdrop against which Gazan children navigate their daily existence.
dek: How three years of Israel’s genocide redefined childhood in Gaza As Israel’s genocide in Gaza entered its fourth year, an entire generation of Gaza’s children have carried on with their lives without a single day of peacetime memory.
title: Israel's war leaves Gaza's children without memory of peace
